evidence.title: BT31014: Immunology
supporting_text: **Immunology** is an undergraduate level course offered by [Department of Biotechnology](/w/Department_of_Biotechnology "Department of Biotechnology") in spring semester of third year (6th semester). It is typically taken by two faculties - Prof. [Sudip Kumar Ghosh](/w/Sudip_Kumar_Ghosh "Sudip Kumar Ghosh"), head of Immunotechnology lab and Dr. [Agneyo Ganguly](/w/Agneyo_Ganguly "Agneyo Ganguly"). It's a 4 credit course with one slot for tutorial class.
